d: Android to PS Vita port of Gameloft's Hero of Sparta
ld: Hero of Sparta is Gameloft's mythological hack-and-slash action game, originally released for Android as Hero Of Sparta HD Free_1.1.4.apk (package com.gameloft.android.GAND.GloftSPAW.ML). This port runs the compiled native library (libheroofsparta.so, armeabi) from the Android release directly on the PS Vita's ARM Cortex-A9 processor, using a dynamic loader (soloader) and an Android environment emulation layer (FalsoJNI), with vitaGL providing the GLES 1.x fixed-function rendering backend.
req:
- A PS Vita / PS TV on Custom Firmware (HENkaku / h-encore / Enso), 3.60-3.74.
- kubridge and FdFix installed as kernel plugins (ur0:tai/config.txt under *KERNEL).
- libshacccg.suprx installed in ur0:data/ (extraction guide).
- A legally obtained copy of Hero of Sparta HD Free v1.1.4 (Hero Of Sparta HD Free_1.1.4.apk) and its downloaded game data folder (/mnt/sdcard/gameloft/games/hos/ from an Android device where the game was installed and run once).
